summary: Alerus Financial Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a cash dividend of $0.22 per share payable October 9, 2026 to holders of record September 25, 2026, and a new stock repurchase program authorizing up to 1,250,000 shares, effective upon completion of the prior program (about 320,033 shares remaining as of August 26, 2026) or its expiration on February 18, 2027. The new program expires August 26, 2029. Repurchases may occur in open market transactions under Rule 10b-18 or via Rule 10b5-1 plans. No repurchase obligation exists; timing depends on market conditions and regulatory factors. What to watch: pace of buyback execution relative to the prior program's remaining capacity.
